evidence.note: Status, issuer, destination and InResponseTo pass. The assertion is encrypted, so audience, recipient, time window, NameID, attributes and signature could not be checked.

output.fix: Have the IdP sign the Response, or sign the assertion before encrypting it. The SP can then verify a signature before it decrypts. Keep signature validation against the configured IdP certificate. After that, re-run the check on the decrypted assertion to confirm audience, recipient, time window, NameID format and the required attributes.

alternatives.why_not: Nothing shows that decryption failed. The validator does not decrypt in this version, so the assertion was simply not inspected.

The expected values do not say a signature is required (require_signed_response and require_signed_assertion are unset). The tool also skipped the signature checks because there is no assertion to inspect.
